title: Origins Aquaphis
description: The official Aquaphis Origin from the Lornwood SMP
body:
# The Aquaphis Origin
## The official Origin from the Lornwood SMP now in its Public State

Required Mods

- [Pehkui](https://modrinth.com/mod/pehkui) (for the size)
- [Apugli](https://modrinth.com/mod/apugli) (To be able to eat the Ores)
- [Eggolib](https://modrinth.com/mod/eggolib/versions) (required)


## Origin Info
Check the Gallery for a cleaner view

## Lore
You are a deep sea mammal, such that you can survive easily in the ocean, though are unwieldly on land. Your people traditionally live in pods, and trade wares with fishermen.

### Fire vulnerability
A oceanic being is not used to contact from intense heat and fire, and it injures you more severely

### Fish are friends
Fish are part of your ecosystem, and will not attack you in your home environment

### Gills
You breathe underwater as others do on land

### Ocean's bounty
Your keen eyes are naturally attuned to find shiny treasures under the sea, and you have more luck than other creatures

### Powerful Fins
Your fins and tail are strong, they asist in swimming at high speeds

### Sea legs
Your legs are not meant to support your larger body on land, and thus they are weaker

### Oceanic creature
You are a sea creature, growing larger than most land animals

### Surge
Dash quickly through the water with aid from your great tail

### Water pulse
Manipulate the water around you to throw others away from yourself

### Wet Floor
You no longer have to worry dragging your Heavy Fishtail across the dry floor.
